cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: The Same Ending
cards.instruction: Use every new emotional detail as evidence that the same feared ending is becoming inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've cancelled lunch. Please don't tell me it's just one meal; that's how the key comes back a month later.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm exhausted. I haven't asked for a key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. You're mixing stages. First I'm tiring, then my calls are tiring, then you need your space. I've been through this.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow, then. I'll book our usual table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A public place. Yes, that's the next stage. Book the corner, please; if you're going to leave me, I'd rather not have to stand up in the middle of the room.
